# ledger_merchant (Resource)

A Ledger merchant record: a stable identifier, a display name and the alias names transactions are matched by. Categories and labels are assigned to it with `ledger_category_assignment` and `ledger_label_assignment` (`object_type = "merchant"`). Creating one makes the display name its first alias; renaming adds the new name as an alias. Merging duplicates is done in Ledger itself, not here. Merchant routes need an API token with the administrator-only `merchants:read` and `merchants:write` grants (merchant names derive from bank text).

Import with the identifier: `terraform import ledger_merchant.example <id>`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A merchant record: a stable identifier, a display name and the aliases transactions are matched by.
# Needs an API token with the administrator-only merchants:read and merchants:write grants.
resource "ledger_merchant" "grocer" {
  display_name = "Lidl"
}

# Archive instead of destroying when decisions or assignments refer to the merchant.
resource "ledger_merchant" "closed_shop" {
  display_name = "Corner shop"
  archived     = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `display_name` (String) The name shown for the merchant, 1 to 200 characters. Ledger trims it, collapses white space and normalises Unicode (NFC), so write it that way. A name that another merchant already has as an alias is refused (`merchant_alias_taken`): merge the two in Ledger instead.

### Optional

- `archived` (Boolean) Whether the merchant is archived. An archived merchant keeps its aliases and every assignment, and takes nothing new by identifier. Archive instead of destroying when anything refers to it. Defaults to `false`.

### Read-Only

- `archived_at` (String) When it was archived (RFC 3339, UTC), or null.
- `created_at` (String) When it was created (RFC 3339, UTC).
- `id` (String) The Ledger identifier (a ULID). It never changes, so a rename keeps every assignment.
- `merged_into` (String) The identifier of the merchant this one was merged into (in Ledger), or null. A merged merchant is archived and cannot be unarchived.
- `updated_at` (String) When it last changed (RFC 3339, UTC).
- `version` (Number) The optimistic-concurrency version. Changes are sent against the version Terraform last read; a stale one fails instead of overwriting.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# By identifier
terraform import ledger_merchant.grocer 01JD3Y4C8V9M2Q7W5R6T0XZBNA
```
